contact_tag_exists: A tag in this change is already on the contact — the contact changed in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
email_already_on_contact: This email address is already on this contact.
external_id_taken: This system already has an external ID on this contact, or this external ID is already used for another contact under the same system.
last_usable_contact_point: A contact keeps at least one usable phone number or email address. Add another one first.
merged_party_row: This row is the copy a contact merge kept; it cannot hold its role again.
vehicle_merged_party_row: This entry belongs to a merged vehicle and stays as history. Edit the entry on vehicle {{vin}}.
phone_already_on_contact: This phone number is already on this contact.
primary_unset_directly: The primary mark cannot be removed directly. Mark another entry as primary instead.
vehicle_merge_in_progress: This vehicle is being merged with another record right now. Please try again in a moment.
contact_group_unknown: This contact group does not exist.
contact_group_not_enabled: This contact group is not switched on in your business. The management switches it on under Administration › Contact groups.
contact_group_read_only: This contact group is not switched on in your business and cannot be removed here.
contact_group_assignment_exists: A contact group in this change is already on the contact — the contact changed in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
customer_role_required: This field belongs to the customer role, which this contact does not hold. Give it the customer role first.
customer_role_not_permitted: The customer role and its fields (status, advisor, credit block, block) are changed by sales and aftersales. Your role gives contacts the supplier role.
customer_role_credit_blocked: The customer role cannot be removed while a credit block stands. Lift the block first.
customer_role_blocked: The customer role cannot be removed while the contact is blocked. Lift the block first.
contact_block_reason_required: A reason is required to block a contact.
contact_role_exists: The contact already holds a role in this change — it changed in the meantime. Reload it and try again.
